scenarios.prompt: Fixed costs = $180,000/year. Selling price = $45 per unit. Variable cost = $27 per unit. Compute break-even quantity (units), break-even revenue, contribution margin per unit, and contribution margin ratio.

Fixed costs $250,000. Price $120, variable cost $72. Management wants an $80,000 target profit (not just break-even). Compute the quantity needed to reach that profit, the corresponding revenue, contribution margin per unit, and contribution margin ratio. Formula: Q = (Fixed + Target) / (Price - VC).
